arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. As it belongs to the landlord, we've asked them whether you can fit your own machine. We've noted that yours would stay your property, wouldn't be on the inventory, and would go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old machine and fitting the new one. Please don't disconnect or dispose of the old machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.
